plan: v15 generalisation to changed plants (blind, frozen controllers, no training)
written: 2026-10-24, before any v15 episode was flown
cases: bench9 stress condition, no hit, seed base 2_103_000_000, 64 per task x 3 tasks = 192; the SAME seeds on every plant
plants: blind15.TESTS: nominal; lower body +25 %; lower +12.5 % with its CoM 3 mm lower; wing mass +30 %; span -5 % / +5 %; chord -10 %; left span -3 % (asymmetry); feathering range -20 %; air density -10 %; battery voltage -10 %; motor kt -10 %; actuator lag x1.5; 'unit B' combination
metrics: crashes of 192 (Clopper-Pearson); abs = mean score ratio on the classical opponent's NOMINAL-plant medians (one scale across plants); degradation = abs(plant) - abs(nominal), same arm, same seeds; paired delta vs classical on the same plant

criteria.G1_per_plant: an SNN11 seed generalises on a plant if its crashes <= classical crashes on that plant AND its degradation <= classical degradation + 0.05; G1 holds on the plant if >= 3 of 5 seeds pass
criteria.G2_overall: the SNN layer generalises if G1 holds on every plant that the classical opponent still flies (classical crashes <= 19/192); plants with classical crashes > 19 are reported as stress results, not counted
criteria.negative: any plant where G1 fails is reported as a limitation with its crash cases

amendment_1.written: 2026-10-26, after the first v15 results, before any amendment episode
amendment_1.plants: lower110 (lower body +10 %), lower1175 (+17.5 %): with nominal and lower125 a four-point dose curve; span102 (span +2 %) and feather90 (feathering range -10 %): smaller doses of two directions that were outside the thrust range
amendment_1.procedure: all four plants are flown in full; a plant with classical crashes > 19/192 is reported as outside the flyable envelope and not counted (G2 rule)
amendment_1.arms: classical, cls_es_s1, snn11_s1..s5, mlp_ppo_s1..s5 (cls_es_s2 dropped to save time)
amendment_1.criteria: G1 / G2 of this plan, unchanged
